name: 青绿网格弧字圆窗

readiness.scope: 已有机制演示通过；精细版仅所列原生窗口经过实际编码审核，其他真实编排仍待完成。

source.author: 小丁带你剪爆款
source.title: 新手0基础也想快速做网感视频？你需要这个 剪辑软件是开拍

semantic_use: 从口播进入编号或步骤说明。
observed_motion: 人物退进圆形窗口，标题沿上弧排列，下方短句沿下弧出现，背景变成青绿网格。

basic_implementation.scope: 圆窗与弧形文字版式、进场顺序。
basic_implementation.parameter_scope: Listed parameters are runtime spec fields. Design variables such as band ratios, path coordinates and entry timing remain authored engine defaults and require a project-specific code adaptation; not an arbitrary automatic inverse-effects system.
basic_implementation.preview_limit: Early four-second mechanism and alternate-content samples are simplified; they do not establish native fidelity or arbitrary filmed-foreground reuse.

presenter_rules.opening: 本人画面承担开头与立场
presenter_rules.returns: 按重要观点、情绪转折和收尾回到人物，不机械每N秒，不只出现一次。
presenter_rules.fit: 匹配本人的取景、脸部占窗和真实上半身，不能扩展不存在的人体像素。
presenter_rules.alpha: 需前景人物效果时用与实际母片时间一致的动态alpha，不能用静态抠像替代移动人物。

adaptation.new_clip_reference: New reference/reference-native specs bind the accepted user master and its native window/SHA/PTS. Learned tutorial provenance stays in this recipe. Reusing an existing recipe does not require redownloading/restudying its tutorial.
adaptation.trigger: 根据当前口播真实词轴触发，保持选定配色/文字体系/层次/动作顺序。
adaptation.missing_measurement: 原字体、原工程和未覆盖分支如实标记；授权替代字体重排后检查当前文案。

validation.basic_mechanism_preview: Original 30 source entries and28 modules each have actual primary/replacement-content preview records in assets/social-grammars/validation.json.

residuals: Reference face, gestures and photographic room are replaced by licensed real moving stock; silence is technical animation study, no lip-sync claim.
Source font family and vector extrusion unavailable. Private isolated glyphs preserve only fixed phrases; new wording uses approximate editable font and measured arc geometry.
Upper type particle entrance is retained as isolated per-native-frame colored/black foreground; no editable original project or arbitrary phrase equivalence.
Motion-blurred circle entry F230–232 manually bounded; white-ring fit F233..302 measures compressed edges with 1–3px uncertainty.
Background sampled from clear lower strip and tiled; native grid colors/textural role retained but original hidden texture not recovered.
Different stock aspect/crop may show headset instead of source microphone; subject content remains independent.
Initial arrow chart uses green/black foreground only; compressed edge transparency and shadows approximate.
White ring entry fade/blur F230–234 is visually bounded; exact motion-direction blur unavailable.
Original creator identification is deliberately replaced by generic demo text in same native region; different branding content/approximate font.
Caption per-character gray forecast trail under190RGB is not recovered from photographic background; private white foreground preserves actual revealed characters.
Background actor/type-covered regions estimated from clear periodic grid; known reference background retained, edge seams may remain.

Subject hair-to-chin scale calibrated to measured native original height ratio0.634, using dynamic RVM matte and separate widened plant background. Original microphone/hands and stock headphones differ.
Plant background is enlarged/rebuilt clean source strip; not recovered original room. Subject chest is visible but no stock hand gesture is invented.
RVM headphone edge can be partly transparent; glyphs and border are separate, accessory alpha residual remains.
Original stock frame cuts off shoulders at image sides; per-frame torso-only alpha taper softens visible crop seam. Missing hands/uncaptured body cannot be recovered; no invented gesture.

Next-caption gray forecast uses final private phrase stencil at estimated20%opacity dark-gray fill; original per-character gray opacity under raw body is not recoverable. White revealed characters retain native positions/timing with1–2px contour uncertainty.
Last native F363 begins next enlarged caption; fixed glyph restored, subsequent full semantic phrase is a separate unrebuilt source variant, not represented by selected circle window.
F230–232原片明显带方向性冲刷，新片使用估计Gaussian模糊和手测圆窗边界，方向核和初始中心轨迹仍有差异。
可见网格取源清晰区域；隐藏人物/字后网格用周期平铺估计，局部纹理相位/拼接色缝仍可能不同。
原男生双手/麦克风与真实stock耳麦、嘴型不同；新素材胸口可见、双手未拍到；重建背景为放大植物清晰条，不是原房间。
逐字灰色预告以最终固定字形20%opacity估计，F321–348源照片下灰字强度无法精确分离；白字边缘1–2px、源压缩阴影和字体材质有差异。
个人履历标签改成研究示例品牌信息，文字内容和字体不同；F363后下一语义段未由此主窗口重建。

font.source_family: unknown from compressed reference; fixed isolated glyph study only
font.editable_fallback: NotoSansSC/available system font, approximate shape must be separately reviewed

grammar.event_policy: real measured source events; cut/pulse/path ordering preserved, new narration must align to accepted word clock

subject_fit_rule: Calibrate native face/head envelope to reference window before rendering; if source shot too close use real per-frame matte with separately declared rebuilt scenery, never silently enlarge a head

replacement_limits.fixed_source_glyphs: not editable; new phrase requires approximate font or separately identified licensed original font
replacement_limits.timing: reuse native enter/hold/exit proportions, map to new word/semantic clock with no claim of exact same phrase animation
replacement_limits.subject: different footage must be reframed and reviewed rather than copied old face coordinates
